cues.text:
嗨，大家好，好久不见
hāi, dàjiā hǎo, hǎojiǔbujiàn
Hi everyone, long time no see

最近我都没怎么出门因为
zuìjìn wǒ dōu méi zěnme chūmén yīnwèi
I haven't been going out much lately, because

7月在上海
7 yuè zài shànghǎi
in July, in Shanghai,

天气真的不怎么样
tiānqì zhēn de bùzěnmeyàng
the weather is really not great

先是连续不断的梅雨季
xiān shì liánxùbùduàn de méiyǔ jì
First came the endless plum rain season

每天都下雨
měitiān dūxià yǔ
It rained every day

又潮湿又闷热
yòu cháoshī yòu mēnrè
Humid and muggy

然后这几天上海又受到台风的影响
ránhòu zhèjǐtiān shànghǎi yòu shòudào táifēng de yǐngxiǎng
And these past few days, Shanghai has been affected by a typhoon

我也不太敢出门
wǒ yě bù tài gǎn chūmén
So I haven't really dared to go out

你们可以看到今天风还是挺大的
nǐmen kěyǐ kàn dào jīntiān fēng háishi tǐng dà de
You can see the wind is still pretty strong today

不过从明天周一起
bùguò cóng míngtiān zhōuyī qǐ
But starting tomorrow, Monday,

上海应该就不太受台风的影响
shànghǎi yīnggāi jiù bù tài shòu táifēng de yǐngxiǎng
Shanghai shouldn't be affected by the typhoon much anymore

那其实今天我也不是要出门
nà qíshí jīntiān wǒ yě bùshì yào chūmén
Actually, I'm not really "going out" today

我只是要去我的邻居朋友家
wǒ zhǐshì yào qù wǒ de línjū péngyou jiā
I'm just going to my neighbor friend's place

帮她照顾一下小猫
bāng tā zhàogu yīxià xiǎomāo
to help take care of her cat

因为她最近去别的城市出差了
yīnwèi tā zuìjìn qù biéde chéngshì chūchāi le
because she's away on a business trip in another city

然后我也就是想跟你们分享一下
ránhòu wǒ yějiùshì xiǎng gēn nǐmen fēnxiǎng yīxià
And I just wanted to share with you

我这几天照顾小猫的心得
wǒ zhèjǐtiān zhàogu xiǎomāo de xīndé
what I've learned from taking care of the cat these past few days

因为我是没有养宠物的经验的
yīnwèi wǒ shì méiyǒu yǎng chǒngwù de jīngyàn de
Because I have zero experience with pets

然后我发现
ránhòu wǒ fāxiàn
And I've found that

和小猫相处比我想象中的要复杂很多
hé xiǎomāo xiāngchǔ bǐ wǒ xiǎngxiàng zhòngdì yào fùzá hěn duō
getting along with a cat is way more complicated than I imagined

也并不是那么顺利
yě bìngbù shì nàme shùnlì
It hasn't gone all that smoothly either

因为可能我们不养宠物的人
yīnwèi kěnéng wǒmen bù yǎng chǒngwù de rén
Maybe because those of us without pets

对于小猫小狗的认知都是来源于
duìyú xiǎomāo xiǎogǒu de rènzhī dōu shì láiyuányú
get all our ideas about cats and dogs from

网上的视频
wǎngshàng de shìpín
videos online

比如说你可以开心的摸摸它
bǐrú shuō nǐ kěyǐ kāixīn de mō mō tā
Like, you can just happily pet them

在中文里我们会叫
zài zhōngwén lǐ wǒmen huì jiào
In Chinese we call it

撸猫撸狗
lū māo lū gǒu
"lū māo lū gǒu" (stroking cats and dogs)

和它玩，它很听话
hé tā wán, tā hěn tīnghuà
You play with them, they're well-behaved

也不反抗
yě bù fǎnkàng
They don't resist

随便你怎么摸
suíbiàn nǐ zěnme mō
You can pet them however you like

但是现实中往往不是这样的
dànshì xiànshí zhōng wǎngwǎng bùshì zhèyàng de
But in reality, it's often not like that

那本来我朋友给我的任务就是每天
nà běnlái wǒ péngyou gěi wǒ de rènwu jiùshì měitiān
Originally, the task my friend gave me was to go every day,

或者每隔两天就去她家帮小猫铲屎
huòzhě měigé liǎng tiān jiù qù tā jiā bāng xiǎomāo chǎn shǐ
or every other day, to her place to scoop the cat's poop

对，去它拉便便的盆子里帮它铲屎
duì, qù tā lā biànbiàn de pénzi lǐ bāng tā chǎn shǐ
Yes, to scoop the poop out of its litter box

说到铲屎
shuō dào chǎn shǐ
Speaking of scooping poop,

我想教你们一个词
wǒ xiǎng jiào nǐmen yígè cí
I want to teach you a word

就是在中文里最近比较火的一个词
jiùshì zài zhōngwén lǐ zuìjìn bǐjiào huǒ de yígè cí
A word that's quite trendy in Chinese lately

叫做“铲屎官”
jiàozuò "chǎn shǐ guān"
It's called "chǎnshǐguān" (poop-scooping officer)

“官”的意思就是官员
"guān" de yìsi jiùshì guānyuán
"Guān" means an official

尤其是古代那种比较大
yóuqíshì gǔdài nàzhǒng bǐjiào dà
Especially the high-ranking,

比较正式的政府的官
bǐjiào zhèngshì de zhèngfǔ de guān
formal government officials of ancient times

但是他们把“官”加在“铲屎”后面
dànshì tāmen bǎ "guān" jiā zài "chǎn shǐ" hòumiàn
But when people add "guān" after "scooping poop",

就有一种自嘲的感觉
jiù yǒu yīzhǒng zìcháo de gǎnjué
it has a self-deprecating feel

把铲屎当做一种工作
bǎ chǎn shǐ dàngzuò yīzhǒng gōngzuò
treating poop-scooping as a job

其实我觉得这个词也很有意思
qíshí wǒ juéde zhège cí yě hěn yǒuyìsi
Actually, I think this word is really interesting

因为它也是在告诉想养宠物的人
yīnwèi tā yě shì zài gàosu xiǎng yǎng chǒngwù de rén
because it's also telling people who want a pet:

养宠物并不只是它们给你
yǎng chǒngwù bìngbù zhǐshì tāmen gěi nǐ
having a pet isn't just about them giving you

提供陪伴或者休闲娱乐
tígōng péibàn huòzhě xiūxián yúlè
companionship or entertainment

你也是有责任的
nǐ yě shì yǒuzérèn de
You have responsibilities too

而铲屎就是最基础的一种
ér chǎn shǐ jiùshì zuì jīchǔ de yīzhǒng
And scooping poop is the most basic one

哎呀这风太大了
āiyā zhè fēng tài dà le
Whoa, this wind is so strong

所以今天这个视频
suǒyǐ jīntiān zhège shìpín
So in today's video,

我并不会带你们出门玩
wǒ bìngbù huì dài nǐmen chūmén wán
I won't be taking you out anywhere fun

我现在要去我朋友的家
wǒ xiànzài yào qù wǒ péngyou de jiā
I'm heading to my friend's place now

然后我想看看能不能录到一点
ránhòu wǒ xiǎng kànkan néng bùnéng lù dào yīdiǎn
And I want to see if I can film a bit of

我和小猫互动的视频给你们看
wǒ hé xiǎomāo hùdòng de shìpín gěi nǐmen kàn
me interacting with the cat to show you

然后如果你们当中有资深的养猫人士
ránhòu rúguǒ nǐmen dāngzhōng yǒu zīshēn de yǎng māo rénshì
And if any of you are experienced cat owners,

也可以给我提供一些经验
yě kěyǐ gěi wǒ tígōng yīxiē jīngyàn
feel free to share some tips with me

因为我也是打算可能在
yīnwèi wǒ yě shì dǎsuàn kěnéng zài
Because I'm actually planning, maybe

今年年底就开始养一只小猫
jīnnián niándǐ jiù kāishǐ yǎng yìzhī xiǎomāo
by the end of this year, to get a cat myself

那就看看今天我到
nà jiù kànkan jīntiān wǒ dào
So let's see, when I get to

朋友家录视频的时候
péngyou jiā lù shìpín de shíhou
my friend's place and start filming,

它赏不赏脸吧
tā shǎng bù shǎngliǎn ba
whether the cat will grace us with its presence

说不定它都不愿意出现在摄像头中
shuōbudìng tā dōu bùyuàn yì chūxiàn zài shèxiàngtóu zhōng
Maybe it won't even want to appear on camera

现在我要先进行一个铲屎的工作
xiànzài wǒ yào xiānjìn xíng yígè chǎn shǐ de gōngzuò
Now, first, I shall perform my poop-scooping duties

它对于这个新相机超级好奇呢
tā duìyú zhège xīn xiàngjī chāojí hàoqí ne
She's super curious about this new camera

嘿嘿
hēihēi
Hehe

涨薪，涨薪
zhǎng xīn, zhǎng xīn
Zhangxin, Zhangxin

这只小猫叫“涨薪”
zhè zhǐ xiǎomāo jiào "zhǎng xīn"
This cat is called "Zhǎngxīn"

其实zhǎngxīn有两个不同的意思
qíshí zhǎ ngxī n yǒu liǎng gè bùtóng de yìsi
Actually, "zhǎngxīn" has two different meanings

怎么说呢
zěnmeshuōne
How do I put it...

它的主人给它取的名字就是“涨薪水”
tā de zhǔrén gěi tā qǔ de míngzi jiùshì "zhǎng xīnshuǐ"
The name her owner gave her means "get a raise" (涨薪水)
The name her owner gave her means " get a raise" (zhǎng xīnshuǐ)

因为她希望自己薪水能
yīnwèi tā xīwàng zìjǐ xīnshuǐ néng
because she hopes her salary can

慢慢慢慢的越来越多
mànmàn mànmàn de yuèláiyuè duō
slowly, slowly keep growing

但是我们还有一个zhǎngxīn
dànshì wǒmen háiyǒu yígè zhǎ ngxī n
But there's another "zhǎngxīn"

就是这个掌心
jiùshì zhège zhǎngxīn
which is this one: 掌心
which is this one: zhǎngxīn

手掌的中心
shǒuzhǎng de zhōngxīn
the center of your palm

所以你们知道有时候确实要看汉字
suǒyǐ nǐmen zhīdào yǒushíhou quèshí yàokàn hànzì
So you see, sometimes you really need the characters

和语境才能知道我们说的是哪个词
hé yǔjìng cáinéng zhīdào wǒmen shuō de shì nǎge cí
and the context to know which word we mean

涨薪，我给你买了新的玩具
zhǎng xīn, wǒ gěi nǐ mǎi le xīn de wánjù
Zhangxin, I bought you new toys

但是我不知道质量怎么样
dànshì wǒ bùzhī dào zhìliàng zěnmeyàng
But I don't know how good the quality is

这是一个弹力球
zhè shì yígè tánlì qiú
This is a bouncy ball

然后上面有一个小的羽毛
ránhòu shàngmiàn yǒu yígè xiǎode yǔmáo
with a little feather on top

因为涨薪在我来的时候
yīnwèi zhǎng xīn zài wǒ lái de shíhou
Because when I first came, Zhangxin

它只有一个逗猫棒
tā zhǐ yǒu yígè dòu māo bàng
only had one cat teaser wand

然后我发现
ránhòu wǒ fāxiàn
And I noticed

它已经对逗猫棒失去了兴趣
tā yǐjīng duì dòu māo bàng shīqù le xìngqù
she'd already lost interest in it

所以我从昨天开始就
suǒyǐ wǒ cóng zuótiān kāishǐ jiù
So starting yesterday, I

买了一些新的玩具
mǎi le yīxiē xīn de wánjù
bought her some new toys

因为我前几天刚开始照顾它的时候
yīnwèi wǒ qiánjǐtiān gāng kāishǐ zhàogu tā de shíhou
Because when I first started taking care of her,

我发现我有一个错误的地方
wǒ fāxiàn wǒ yǒu yígè cuòwù de dìfāng
I realized I was making a mistake:

就是我会用手陪它玩
jiùshì wǒ huì yòng shǒu péi tā wán
I would play with her using my hands

然后它就特别喜欢咬我手
ránhòu tā jiù tèbié xǐhuan yǎo wǒ shǒu
And she loved biting my hand

我就去想为什么
wǒ jiù qù xiǎng wèishénme
So I tried to figure out why

就是因为每次它咬我手
jiùshì yīnwèi měicì tā yǎo wǒ shǒu
It's because every time she bit my hand,

我就会习惯性的
wǒ jiù huì xíguànxìng de
I would habitually,

本能的抽回
běnnéng de chōu huí
instinctively pull it back

这就跟它在自然里看到的猎物一样
zhè jiù gēn tā zài zìrán lǐ kàn dào de lièwù yīyàng
which is exactly like the prey she'd see in nature

对吧？涨薪它原来是生活在街道上的
duì ba? zhǎng xīn tā yuánlái shì shēnghuó zài jiēdào shàng de
Right? Zhangxin used to live on the streets

它几个月大的时候
tā jǐge yuè dà de shíhou
When she was a few months old,

主人把它捡回来
zhǔrén bǎ tā jiǎn huílai
her owner took her in

然后我就开始
ránhòu wǒ jiù kāishǐ
So I started —

先是用这些玩具去让它
xiān shì yòng zhèxiē wánjù qù ràng tā
first, using these toys to let her

释放一些它捕猎的天性
shìfàng yīxiē tā bǔliè de tiānxìng
release some of her hunting instincts

然后我的手可能就对它失去了
ránhòu wǒ de shǒu kěnéng jiù duì tā shīqù le
That way, my hand would probably lose

原来那种猎物的吸引力
yuánlái nàzhǒng lièwù de xīyǐnlì
its original prey-like appeal to her

其次我改的就是
qícì wǒ gǎi de jiùshì
The second thing I changed:

我会放在那里不动
wǒ huì fàng zàinàli bùdòng
I keep it still, not moving,

让它看起来不那么像猎物
ràng tā kànqǐlai bù nàme xiàng lièwù
so it looks less like prey

然后它再咬
ránhòu tā zài yǎo
And if she bites again,

我就会发出“嘶——”的声音提醒它
wǒ jiù huì fāchū "sī——" de shēngyīn tíxǐng tā
I make a "hiss—" sound to warn her

然后它好像真的能听懂
ránhòu tā hǎoxiàng zhēn de néng tīngdǒng
And she really seems to understand

能看出我不喜欢它咬我手
néng kànchū wǒ bù xǐhuan tā yǎo wǒ shǒu
She can tell I don't like her biting my hand

还有一个新的逗猫棒
háiyǒu yígè xīn de dòu māo bàng
There's also a new teaser wand

它就是长得跟棒棒糖一样
tā jiùshì zhǎngde gēn bàngbàngtáng yīyàng
It looks just like a lollipop

然后下面也吊了一根
ránhòu xiàmiàn yě diào le yī gēn
with a feather hanging from it —

对猫很有吸引力的羽毛
duì māo hěn yǒu xīyǐnlì de yǔmáo
the kind cats find irresistible

涨薪
zhǎng xīn
Zhangxin

然后我看网上别人说
ránhòu wǒ kàn wǎngshàng biéren shuō
I read online that

动这个逗猫棒的时候
dòng zhège dòu māo bàng de shíhou
when you move the teaser wand,

要让它不那么有规律的动
yào ràng tā bù nàme yǒu guīlù de dòng
you should move it irregularly

因为自然界里的猎物
yīnwèi zìránjiè lǐ de lièwù
because prey in nature

动起来也是没有规律的
dòng qilai yě shì méiyǒu guīlù de
doesn't move in regular patterns either

它现在在观察
tā xiànzài zài guānchá
She's observing now

还是引起了一些它的兴趣的哦
háishi yǐnqǐ le yīxiē tā de xìngqù de ó
It did catch her interest a little!

爱玩儿是好事
ài wánr shì hǎoshì
Loving to play is a good thing

它现在身上还穿着绝育服
tā xiànzài shēnshang hái chuānzhuó juéyù fú
She's still wearing her recovery suit

因为它大概一周前刚做完绝育
yīnwèi tā dàgài yīzhōu qián gāng zuòwán juéyù
because she was spayed about a week ago

然后这个绝育的小衣服就是
ránhòu zhège juéyù de xiǎo yīfu jiùshì
This little recovery outfit is

保护它的伤口的
bǎohù tā de shāngkǒu de
to protect her wound

所以我现在也不敢让它动太多
suǒyǐ wǒ xiànzài yě bù gǎn ràng tā dòng tài duō
So I don't dare let her move too much right now

因为可能伤口还没有完全恢复好
yīnwèi kěnéng shāngkǒu hái méiyǒu wánquán huīfù hǎo
since the wound may not be fully healed yet

这么快就失去兴趣了今天
zhème kuài jiù shīqù xìngqù le jīntiān
Lost interest that fast today, huh

涨薪
zhǎng xīn
Zhangxin

然后我看网上说
ránhòu wǒ kàn wǎngshàng shuō
I also read online that

陪它们玩之后
péi tāmen wán zhīhòu
after playing with them,

要给它们喂点零食
yào gěi tāmen wèi diǎn língshí
you should feed them a little treat

这样它们就真的会
zhèyàng tāmen jiù zhēn de huì
That way they'll really

觉得自己捕到猎一样
juéde zìjǐ bǔ dào liè yīyàng
feel like they caught their prey

哎，人类真的是能想出各种办法
āi, rénlèi zhēn de shì néng xiǎngchū gèzhǒng bànfǎ
Wow, humans really can come up with anything

这个你吃吗？
zhège nǐ chī ma?
Will you eat this one?

那还是吃的
nà háishi chī de
Okay, so you do eat it

看来你不喜欢这个黄色的零食
kànlai nǐ bù xǐhuan zhège huángsè de língshí
Looks like you don't like this yellow treat

那我以后不喂你了
nà wǒ yǐhòu bù wèi nǐ le
Fine, I won't feed you this one anymore

它现在想跟我保持一定的距离
tā xiànzài xiǎng gēn wǒ bǎochí yīdìng de jùlí
She wants to keep some distance from me right now

那我就让它这样自己待着
nà wǒ jiù ràng tā zhèyàng zìjǐ dài zhe
So I'll just let her be on her own

因为不管是动物还是人
yīnwèi bùguǎn shì dòngwù háishi rén
Because whether it's animals or people,

我们都要有一定的边界感
wǒmen dōu yàoyǒu yīdìng de biānjiè gǎn
we all need a sense of boundaries

就是不能总是主动往对方身上靠
jiùshì bùnéng zǒngshì zhǔdòng wǎng duìfāng shēnshang kào
You can't always be the one leaning in on the other

对不对，涨薪？
duìbùduì, zhǎng xīn?
Right, Zhangxin?

它特别喜欢这样踩在我的脚上
tā tèbié xǐhuan zhèyàng cǎi zài wǒ de jiǎo shàng
She really loves standing on my feet like this

涨薪~
zhǎng xīn~
Zhangxin~

然后我发现现在伸手给它
ránhòu wǒ fāxiàn xiànzài shēnshǒu gěi tā
And I've found that now when I offer her my hand,

它好像真的不咬了，你看
tā hǎoxiàng zhēn de bù yǎo le, nǐ kàn
she really doesn't bite anymore — look

它反倒是贴过来让我摸
tā fǎndào shì tiē guòlai ràng wǒ mō
Instead, she comes close and lets me pet her

然后我就觉得这几天
ránhòu wǒ jiù juéde zhèjǐtiān
So I feel like these past few days,

好像真的找对了点方法
hǎoxiàng zhēn de zhǎo duìle diǎn fāngfǎ
